notes: Artifacts contain aggregate-only business target comparison summaries.
No final labels, client-level outputs, raw client ids, row samples, query text, or product names are persisted.

business_target_comparison.business_question: Which active clients are likely to purchase in the target window?
business_target_comparison.data_coverage_note: Default active cohort uses add_to_cart or purchase history.
business_target_comparison.complexity_reason: Requires active-user cohort and future purchase label, but is broad and business-friendly.
business_target_comparison.business_value_reason: Supports campaign targeting and general purchase likelihood scoring.
business_target_comparison.leakage_rule: Features must only use events before cutoff_date. Labels must only use purchase events from cutoff_date to target_end. No target-window behavior should be used in feature calculations.

business_target_comparison.negative_means: possible cart abandonment or no conversion
business_target_comparison.data_coverage_note: Cohort uses clients with add_to_cart history.

recommendation.provisional_label_definition: Eligible clients have at least 1 add_to_cart or purchase event before cutoff_date; positive clients have at least 1 purchase from cutoff_date to target_end; negative clients have no purchase in that target window.
recommendation.reason: purchase_propensity is recommended as the provisional MVP target using a 30-day target window, pending preprocessing validation.

ranking_heuristics: Positive rate closer to 25% improves balance rank; 10% to 40% is considered easier for baseline modeling.
Lower implementation complexity improves complexity rank.
Higher direct business actionability improves business value rank.
leakage_validation: Features must only use events before cutoff_date.
Labels must only use purchase events from cutoff_date to target_end.
No target-window behavior should be used in feature calculations.
